text: RTMI is a private, non-bank financing company based in Kfar Saba, Israel. Its website names Stav Shaham and Chen Shaham under 'בעלי החברה' (the company's owners), and named press covering its Hapoel Tel Aviv sponsorship describes Stav Shaham as the man behind the company.
short: RTMI is a private Israeli financing company; its site names Stav and Chen Shaham as its owners.
